title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - LinearPositioningSystemCoordinate
description: Linear Positioning System Coordinate (era:LinearPositioningSystemCoordinate's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Represents coordinates in a linear positioning system.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LinearPositioningSystemCoordinate'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

kmPost.description: Relationship. The closest kilometric post on the line, used as a reference by the LRS coordinate.

offsetFromKilometricPost.description: Property. Relative distance from a reference kilometric post
